system.description: As a Standard Action, you can make a DC 20 Treat Injury check. If the check succeeds, you know if the organic characters within 6 squares and within your line of sight are below one half of their Hit Points and at what step they are along the Condition Track.

prerequisite.text: Medical Droid species, and Trained in Treat Injury
